2-(a)
```{r}
bubble_sort = function(vec, decreasing = FALSE){
  n = length(vec)
  for (i in 1:(n-1)){
    index = i
    for (j in (i+1):n){
      if (decreasing == FALSE){
        if (vec[j] < vec[index]) index = j
      }
      else{
        if (vec[j] > vec[index]) index = j
      }
    }
    if (index != i){
      temp = vec[i]
      vec[i] = vec[index]
      vec[index] = temp
    }
  }
  return(vec)
}
```

```{r}
set.seed(1)
x = runif(10)
x
```

```{r}
bubble_sort(x, decreasing = FALSE)
```
```{r}
bubble_sort(x, decreasing = TRUE)
```
2-(b)
```{r}
quick_sort = function(vec, decreasing = FALSE){
  n = length(vec)
  
  if (n < 2) {
    return(vec)
  }
  
  pivot = vec[n/2]
  
  if (decreasing == FALSE){
    left = vec[vec < pivot]
    middle = vec[vec == pivot]
    right = vec[vec > pivot]
    return(c(quick_sort(left, decreasing = FALSE), middle, quick_sort(right, decreasing = FALSE)))
  } else {
    left = vec[vec > pivot]
    middle = vec[vec == pivot]
    right = vec[vec < pivot]
    return(c(quick_sort(left, decreasing = TRUE), middle, quick_sort(right, decreasing = TRUE)))
  }
}
```

```{r}
set.seed(1)
x = runif(10)
```

```{r}
quick_sort(x, decreasing = FALSE)
```
```{r}
quick_sort(x, decreasing = TRUE)
```
3-(a)
```{r}
derivative = function(f, x, h, method){
  n = length(x)
  d = numeric(n)
  if (method == "forward"){
    for (i in 1:n){
      d[i] = (f(x[i] + h) - f(x[i])) / h
    }
  }
  else if (method == "backward"){
    for (i in 1:n){
      d[i] = (f(x[i]) - f(x[i] - h)) / h
    }
  }
  else if (method == "central"){
    for (i in 1:n){
      d[i] = (f(x[i] + h) - f(x[i] - h)) / (2*h)
    }
  }
  return(d)
}
```

```{r}
h = 1e-6
x = seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 100)
f = function(x) cos(x)-x
```

```{r}
d_forward = derivative(f, x, h, "forward")
d_backward = derivative(f, x, h, "backward")
d_central = derivative(f, x, h, "central")

d = data.frame(x = rep(x, 4),
               y = c(d_true(x), d_forward, d_backward, d_central),
               method = rep(c("True", "Forward", "Backward", "Central"), each = length(x)))
```

```{r}

ggplot(d, aes(x, y, color = method)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x = "x", y = "y", color = "Method") +
  theme_minimal()
```
3-(b)
```{r}
NR = function(f, fprime, x0, maxiter, h, epsilon){
  x = x0
  for (i in 1:maxiter){
    if (is.null(fprime)){
      d = (f(x+h)-f(x-h))/(2*h)
    }
    else{
      d = fprime(x)
    }
    
    x_new = x - f(x)/d
    
    if (abs(x - x_new) < epsilon){
      return(x_new)
    }
    else{
      x = x_new
    }
  }
  return(x)
}
```

4-(a)
```{r}
left_rectangle = function(f, a, b, n){
  h = (b-a)/n
  x = numeric(n)
  fx = numeric(n)
  sum = 0
  for (i in 1:n){
    x[i] = a + (i-1)*h
    fx[i] = f(x[i])
  }
  for (i in 1:(n)){
    sum = sum + fx[i]
  }
  
  result = h * sum
  return(result)
}
```

4-(b)
```{r}
trapezoid = function(f, a, b, n){
  h = (b-a)/n
  x = numeric(n+1)
  fx = numeric(n+1)
  sum = 0
  for (i in 1:(n+1)){
    x[i] = a + (i-1)*h
    fx[i] = f(x[i])
  }
  for (i in 2:n){
    sum = sum + fx[i]
  }
  
  result = (h/2) * (fx[1] + 2*sum + fx[n+1])
  return(result)
}
```

4-(c)
```{r}
simpson = function(f, a, b, n){
  if (n %% 2 != 0){
    stop("n is not even")
  }
  
  h = (b-a)/n
  x = numeric(n+1)
  fx = numeric(n+1)
  sum1 = 0
  sum2 = 0
  
  for (i in 1:(n+1)){
    x[i] = a + (i-1)*h
    fx[i] = f(x[i])
  }
  
  for (i in 2:n){
    if (i %% 2 == 0){
      sum1 = sum1 + fx[i]
    }
    else{
      sum2 = sum2 + fx[i]
    }
  }
  
  result = (h / 3) * (fx[1] + 4 * sum1 + 2 * sum2 + fx[n+1])
  return(result)
}
```

5-(b)
```{r}
forward = function(L, b){
  n = length(b)
  z = numeric(n)
  
  for (i in 1:n){
    sum = 0
    
    if (i > 1){
      for (j in 1:(n-1)){
      sum = sum + L[i, j] * z[j]
      }
    }
    
    z[i] = (b[i] - sum) / L[i, i]
  }
  
  return(z)
}
```

5-(c)
```{r}
backward = function(L, z){
  n = length(z)
  x = numeric(n)
  
  for (i in n:1){
    sum = 0
    
    if (i < n){
    
    for (j in (i+1):n){
      sum = sum + L[j, i] * x[j]
      }
    }
    
    x[i] = (z[i] - sum) / L[i, i]
    
  }
  
  return(x)
}
```

6-(a)
```{r}
gaussian_kernel = function(x1, x2, rho){
  result = exp(-rho * (x1 - x2)^2)
  return(result)
}
```

6-(b)
```{r}
krr = function(x, y, rho, lambda){
  n = nrow(x)
  k = matrix(0, n, n)
  
  for (i in 1:n){
    for (j in 1:n){
      k[i, j] = gaussian_kernel(x[i, 1], x[j, 1], rho)
    }
  }
  
  alpha = solve(k + lambda * diag(n), y)
  
  result = list(x = x, y = y, alpha = alpha, rho = rho, lambda = lambda)
  class(result) = "krr"
  
  return(result)
}
```

6-(c)
```{r}
predict.krr = function(object, data, ...){
  x = object$x
  alpha = object$alpha
  rho = object$rho
  
  data = as.matrix(data)
  
  n = nrow(x)
  m = nrow(data)
  
  new = matrix(0, m, n)
  
  for (i in 1:m){
    for (j in 1:n){
      new[i, j] = gaussian_kernel(data[i,1], x[j, 1], rho)
    }
  }
  
  y_pred = new %*% alpha
  
  return(as.numeric(y_pred))
}
```

6-(d)
```{r}
plot.krr = function(x, ...){
  x_grid = matrix(seq(min(x$x), max(x$x), length.out = 200), ncol = 1)
  
  y_pred = predict(x, x_grid)
  
  point = data.frame(
    x = x$x[, 1], y = x$y
  )
  
  line = data.frame(
    x = x_grid[, 1], y = y_pred
  )
  
  ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = point, aes(x, y), color = "black") +
    geom_line(data = line, aes(x, y), color = "blue", linewidth = 1) +
    labs(x = "x", y = "y") +
    theme_minimal()
}
```
